correctness.rationale: PASS. For K_{m,n}, m,n≥2, with uniform cross-part rates α,β>0, the generator decomposes into within-X fluctuations e^{-αt}, within-Y fluctuations e^{-βt} and part imbalance e^{-(α+β)t}. A cross Dirac difference has explicit signs, with two optimal primal transport plans and Lipschitz dual potentials yielding max{2(m−1)/m e^{-αt}−(m−2)/m e^{-(α+β)t},2(n−1)/n e^{-βt}−(n−2)/n e^{-(α+β)t}}. Same-part Dirac ratios are dominated; the Dirac-pair reduction proves norm for all measures. Differentiating each branch proves iff α≥(m−2)β/m and β≥(n−2)α/n for global contractivity; violating one yields a unique positive-time global maximum; two violations cannot coexist. Independent full generator expm and graph-Lipschitz dual LP checked three asymmetric cases, including peak 1.056134084152072 at m=n=4,α=1,β=4, t=log(5/3)/4.
